about: The five pull requests that modernized Relay's notification module (Chapter 9, worked example), as tasks for coding agents in separate worktrees. Each worktree under data/worktrees/<task>/ holds the files that task's agent session produced, at their repository paths. The agent sessions are SIMULATED: the files were written for the book and are labelled so; no model produced them. A task's agent starts from the integrated repository as it was when the task's dependencies had merged.
base: Relay 4.21.0 with rule deletion (no relay/notify package)

tasks.title: Import the legacy module unchanged and characterize it
Extract the send decision into a pure function
New tables, a proved migration, and writes to both tables
tasks.rollback: revert (the legacy table was never altered)

Read from the new tables; retire the legacy working copy
